surface.plainText: 3 of 3 rows ready for review Waiting Rows wait here Original Original wording remains visible Add Added rows update Today Review row 2026-06-21 / Bus fare / -3.20 Bus fare Review row 2026-06-22 / Coffee / -3.25 Coffee Review row 2026-06-27 / Payday / 1840.00 Payday Add Edit Ignore Duplicate Transfer Income Bill Debt payment Refund Later Add Adds this row to your money view with the original wording attached. Edit Preserves the original wording, stores your correction and still waits for acceptance. Ignore Keeps the row out of your money view and leaves Today, Timeline and Plans unchanged. Income Marks the row as money coming in, still waiting for your acceptance. Bill Marks the row as a must-pay item, still waiting for your acceptance. Debt payment Marks the row as a debt payment without blame or telling you what to do. Refund Marks the row as money returned, still waiting for your acceptance. Later Leaves the row waiting and changes nothing in your picture.
